title: Dust and Aerosol Measurement Feasibility Test (DAFT) / DAFT-2
scientific_focus: Spacecraft fire safety; aerosol particle measurement instrument qualification
objectives: Validate aerosol particle-counting devices in microgravity before the SAME flight investigation; assess whether particle instruments behave reliably in orbit.
approach: Modify a TSI P-Trak counter for microgravity by adapting its isopropyl-alcohol condenser and removing its gravity-dependent mercury orientation switch. Generate Arizona Red Dust (ARD) aerosols with gaseous nitrogen in Mylar sample bags, test on orbit, and compare P-Trak counts with DustTrak reference measurements.
